scope: Read-only CLI help/parser/unavailable-service probes against isolated data directory. Expected unsupported-command errors prove bounded missing CLI entry points, not feature PASS; no daemon or inference launched. No claim of all 234 Orca commands or platform execution.

results.stdout:
Command-line client for the Drogon runtime (protocol v1)

Usage: drogon-cli [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  status     Show runtime identity, protocol version and capabilities
  workspace  
  terminal   
  harness    Harness discovery and launch (requires service capabilities harness.catalog.v1 / harness.launch.v1)
  rpc        Diagnostic passthrough for a raw protocol method
  help       Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --data-dir <PATH>  Drogon data directory (default: DROGON_DATA_DIR, else platform default)
      --json             Print one JSON envelope on stdout instead of human text
      --request-id <ID>  Caller-chosen request id so a mutation can be replayed byte-equivalently
  -h, --help             Print help
  -V, --version          Print version

Usage: drogon-cli workspace [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  add   Register an existing directory as a workspace
  list  List registered workspaces
  help  Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --data-dir <PATH>  Drogon data directory (default: DROGON_DATA_DIR, else platform default)
      --json             Print one JSON envelope on stdout instead of human text
      --request-id <ID>  Caller-chosen request id so a mutation can be replayed byte-equivalently
  -h, --help             Print help

Usage: drogon-cli terminal [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  create  Start a PTY session running COMMAND with ARGS (after `--`)
  list    List sessions, optionally scoped to one workspace
  read    Read bounded output from a session
  send    Write UTF-8 text to a session (encoded to base64 exactly once)
  resize  Resize a session's PTY
  close   Stop a session and wait for the observed exit
  help    Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --data-dir <PATH>  Drogon data directory (default: DROGON_DATA_DIR, else platform default)
      --json             Print one JSON envelope on stdout instead of human text
      --request-id <ID>  Caller-chosen request id so a mutation can be replayed byte-equivalently
  -h, --help             Print help

Start a session running a harness; the service resolves the host executable, so there is nothing to point at a local binary

Usage: drogon-cli harness start [OPTIONS] --workspace <ID> --harness <ID>

Options:
      --data-dir <PATH>
          Drogon data directory (default: DROGON_DATA_DIR, else platform default)
      --workspace <ID>
          
      --harness <ID>
          Harness id as advertised by `harness list` (server-authoritative; aliases like `agy` are resolved by the service)
      --json
          Print one JSON envelope on stdout instead of human text
      --model <MODEL-ID>
          Exact opaque model id; never guessed, never defaulted
      --request-id <ID>
          Caller-chosen request id so a mutation can be replayed byte-equivalently
      --provider <PROVIDER>
          Pi-only provider selection (server validates adapter policy)
      --effort <VALUE>
          Adapter-specific effort value (server validates against the adapter's documented CLI surface)
      --prompt <TEXT>
          Literal initial prompt: forwarded as one JSON string, never shell interpolated, never @-file expanded
      --permission-mode <PERMISSION_MODE>
          [default: inherit] [possible values: inherit, unattended]
  -h, --help
          Print help
